title: Timed branch configuration
statement: Given finite Boolean Turing machines $D$, $M_1$, and $M_2$, an input string $x$, a configuration $c$ of the branch union of $M_1$ and $M_2$ on $x$, work-tape contents $T$ for the $D$ tapes, work-head positions $h$ for those tapes, and a bit $b$, define a configuration of the timed conditional machine on $x$. It places $c$ in the branch machine's tape and state blocks, places $T$ and $h$ in the $D$ tape block, and initializes the extra tape with the one-bit string $b$ and its head at position zero.
hypotheses_covered: $D$, $M_1$, and $M_2$ are finite Boolean Turing machines
$c$ is a configuration of the branch union of $M_1$ and $M_2$ on $x$
$T$ assigns Boolean-or-blank contents to each $D$ work tape
$h$ assigns an integer head position to each $D$ work tape
